standfirst: Bipartite, 17 features, 107 profiles. RNA1 carries the replicase polyprotein and the RdRp; RNA2 carries the closterovirid quintuple gene block. Shipped after a duplicate-call audit merged three pairs of features that were one protein each and dropped one promiscuous short profile.

modules.Crinivirus: The module originally declared 23 features. A duplicate-call audit found RNASE3 and SUPPRESSOR to be one protein (99% identity over 100% coverage -- in Sweet potato chlorotic stunt virus the RNase3 IS the silencing suppressor), p26/p27/p28 to be one diverged family (23-24% over 96-99%), and p8/p9 and p6/p8 to be two more such families. Those were merged; P23 was dropped as a short profile firing inside P22B with only 29% identity over 35% coverage. 17 features, 90.0% clean.

gaps: HSP70 and HSP90 are still called on identical coordinates in 6% of genomes. That one is biology rather than a defect: the collections share no sequences yet the proteins are 64% identical over 99% coverage, so they are genuine crinivirus paralogues and no cutoff separates them without losing one.
derived: None declared. The ORF1a/1b frameshift readthrough product is annotated on 46 records but is not a feature: ORF1a and the RdRp are called separately, as in the shipped Closterovirus module.

why.P22A: Called on 0.0% of routed genomes. All 26 of its source records sit on genome records under 6 kb and the evaluation population is genomes >=6 kb, so the feature was never offered a genome that could carry it. The profile recovers 26 of its 26 sequences.
why.P25: 8 sequences, 212 aa. Genuinely rare -- all 8 source records are on full-length genomes.
why.P6B: 8 sequences, 51 aa. Discovered cluster, built at -m 2.
why.P7B: Its calls land on RNA1 contigs in about a quarter of genomes despite being declared RNA2. Moving it to RNA1 was tested and made the quality flags worse, so the declaration stands and the segment genuinely varies by species.
why.P8A: One homology group covering the records named p8 and p9: 33-34% identity over 91-99% coverage. Called on 100% of routed genomes.
why.P8B: A second p8-sized cluster merged with the records named p6: 29-36% identity over 79-81% coverage. Called on 48%, so accessory.
